theorem ceil_natCast_add (n : ℕ) (a : R) : ⌈n + a⌉ = n + ⌈a⌉ := by
  simpa [Int.cast_natCast] using (Int.ceil_intCast_add (R := R) (z := (n : ℤ)) a)
